title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
description: Explore the commercial corridors and community spaces within walking distance of Bryn Mawr College, from historic cinemas to student-favorite bagel shops.

cards.title: The 800 Block of Lancaster
cards.subtitle: West Lancaster Avenue
cards.notes: Visit this historic 1926 theater for independent films and student-discounted tickets just steps from the Bryn Mawr train station.
cards.short_summary: A historic non-profit movie theater and cultural hub on Lancaster Avenue.
cards.evidence_claim: The Bryn Mawr Film Institute offers student discount tickets and is a central cultural landmark in downtown Bryn Mawr.
cards.access_notes: Open daily for screenings; check website for specific showtimes and student pricing.

cards.title: The 0 Block of South Bryn Mawr
cards.subtitle: South Bryn Mawr Avenue
cards.notes: Utilize the 'Reading Porch' or the quiet top-floor study areas in this public library located only a few blocks from campus.
cards.short_summary: A large public library serving as a popular off-campus study alternative for students.
cards.evidence_claim: Ludington Library is located a few blocks from campus and features a 'Reading Porch' where food and beverages are permitted.
cards.source_title: My favorite off-campus spots | Rachel Hertzberg's Banter Blog
cards.access_notes: Public access during standard library hours; library card required for borrowing but not for on-site study.

cards.title: The 800 Block of Morris
cards.subtitle: Morris Avenue
cards.notes: Grab a fresh bagel and chai latte at this student-favorite breakfast spot located near the north side of the train station.
cards.short_summary: A popular local bagel shop frequently visited by students for breakfast and study fuel.
cards.evidence_claim: Up-Ryes Bagels is identified as a student favorite for breakfast and study fuel, located very close to the college campus.
cards.source_title: A Student's Guide to Bryn Mawr Town
cards.access_notes: Open early morning through mid-afternoon; popular on weekends.

cards.title: The 900 Block of Lancaster
cards.subtitle: West Lancaster Avenue
cards.notes: Experience this coffee shop housed in a former bus terminal; note that it intentionally does not offer WiFi to encourage conversation.
cards.short_summary: A spacious, high-ceilinged coffee shop known for its industrial aesthetic and social atmosphere.
cards.evidence_claim: La Colombe is located in the Bryn Mawr Village development and purposefully does not offer WiFi to promote social interaction.
cards.source_title: New Bryn Mawr Village Shopping Center - The Villanovan
cards.access_notes: Open daily; large seating area available for groups.

cards.title: The 0 Block of Morris
cards.subtitle: Morris Avenue
cards.notes: Access the Paoli/Thorndale Line for a 20-minute ride to Center City Philadelphia from this station just two blocks from campus.
cards.short_summary: The primary transit link connecting the college to the greater Philadelphia region.
cards.evidence_claim: The Bryn Mawr station is approximately 350 yards from campus and provides regular service to Philadelphia's major stations.
cards.source_title: Directions to Bryn Mawr College | SEPTA, PHL & Driving Info
cards.access_notes: Trains run from approximately 6:15 a.m. to 12:15 a.m. daily.

cards.title: The 1100 Block of Lancaster
cards.subtitle: West Lancaster Avenue
cards.notes: Stop by for freshly baked gourmet cookies, a long-standing tradition for students looking for a late-afternoon treat.
cards.short_summary: A well-known local bakery specializing in a wide variety of gourmet cookies.
cards.evidence_claim: Hope's Cookies is cited as a student favorite for freshly-baked gourmet cookies in the Bryn Mawr area.
cards.source_title: A Student's Guide to Bryn Mawr Town
cards.access_notes: Open daily; shares a building with Snap Custom Pizza.

cards.title: The 800 Block of Lancaster
cards.subtitle: West Lancaster Avenue
cards.notes: Enjoy shared portions of Indian dishes at this restaurant, a frequent choice for student group dinners and movie nights.
cards.short_summary: A popular Indian restaurant offering dine-in and delivery services to the college community.
cards.evidence_claim: Tiffin Indian Cuisine is a student favorite for dinners and offers delivery to the Bryn Mawr campus.
cards.source_title: A Student's Guide to Bryn Mawr Town
cards.access_notes: Open for lunch and dinner; offers free delivery for local orders.

cards.title: The 800 Block of Lancaster
cards.subtitle: West Lancaster Avenue
cards.notes: Explore this whimsical toy store located just a 7-minute walk from campus, popular for unique gifts and collectibles.
cards.short_summary: A local independent toy store known for its curated selection of unique items.
cards.evidence_claim: Lucky Duck Toys is a 7-minute walk from campus and is recommended for students seeking whimsical gifts.
cards.source_title: A Student's Guide to Bryn Mawr Town
cards.access_notes: Open daily; located in the heart of the downtown business district.

cards.title: The 600 Block of Lancaster
cards.subtitle: West Lancaster Avenue
cards.notes: Shop for groceries and essentials at this supermarket, which is the primary full-service grocery store within walking distance.
cards.short_summary: The main local supermarket serving the Bryn Mawr student and residential community.
cards.evidence_claim: ACME Markets at 601 W Lancaster Ave is the local supermarket for the Bryn Mawr area.
cards.source_title: Grocery Store Near Me - ACME Markets in Bryn Mawr, PA
cards.access_notes: Open daily from early morning until late evening; accepts SNAP and EBT.

cards.title: The 800 Block of Lancaster
cards.subtitle: West Lancaster Avenue
cards.notes: Visit this newly opened bakery and cafe for sourdough loaves and pastries, featuring a rear entrance for easier access.
cards.short_summary: A new addition to the Lancaster Avenue corridor offering high-quality baked goods and cafe service.
cards.evidence_claim: The Buttery opened its Bryn Mawr location at 836 W. Lancaster Avenue in June 2026.
cards.source_title: Bryn Mawr Summer 2026: What's New on Lancaster Avenue
cards.access_notes: Open daily 7 a.m. to 5 p.m.; kitchen closes for lunch at 3 p.m.
